content:
The intentions reporting / issue claiming mechanism already in use in a number of downstream repositories is now available as a reusable Github Action at https://github.com/leanprover-community/intentions. (The previous version required copying and pasting the implementation into your .github directory.)

This is a rewrite, in Typescript, of prior work by @Pietro Monticone and @Shreyas Srinivas (who have both kindly volunteered to continue as maintainers of the new repo). We also add some features about specifying durations / expiries for intention registration, described in the README.

I've opened PRs already to most of the projects using the old implementation, proposing switching over to the new implementation. (It should be backwards compatible in terms of required repository secrets.) These PRs don't opt-in to the duration/expiry mechanism, but it's a one line change to do so.
